description: Additive HTTP row ingress: validate one multi-vendor CSV row, map it to the versioned JSON contract, route duplicates and failures, and POST canonical events to AgenticNOC.

canonicalization.identity: event_id is the supplied Event ID when present; alarm_key is vendor:site:event_id. Missing identity fields fail validation and are written to the DLQ.

processors.name: Add deterministic identity and delivery metadata

invariants: This flow has no PublishKafka processor and never publishes noc.alarm.raw.v1.
Every successful HTTP request contains one CSV data row; SplitRecord is a defensive guard.
Only valid, non-duplicate mapped JSON reaches InvokeHTTP.
Validation, duplicate, and HTTP failures are observable through noc.route/noc.metric attributes and retained under the DLQ directory.
Source lineage is copied from X-Original-Filename/X-Row-Number and optional replay headers into the mapped contract.
